title: Friends at the lighthouse
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: clear golden morning, warm amber sunlight, calm sparkling ocean, gentle breeze.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important.
Camera: two-shot widening to three; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny and the hero laugh and haul Tomkin upright out of the tub; he straightens his sock toque with dignity and declares his line.
Dialogue: Tomkin (pompous, theatrical, swashbuckling-captain male voice, a little squeaky, grandly overconfident, dignified) says: "A captain never retreats!"
Sound: laughter, gulls, waves.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
